title: goalbench: a reproducible benchmark of choice-style deciders for customer-goal classification in Brazilian Portuguese
description:
goalbench measures small "decider" models that answer typed choice questions (Laya, Strands Decider) on customer-goal classification in Brazilian Portuguese, inside a two-stage pipeline: an embedding shortlist of 10 goals followed by the decider, with a calibrated combination fitted by cross-validation. Runs log every phrase, control for option-order (position) bias, and report Wilson intervals and exact McNemar tests. A parallel English translation of the dataset measures the accuracy lost in Brazilian Portuguese and the gain from a language-specific checkpoint.

The archive includes the code (Apache-2.0), the synthetic datasets (CC BY 4.0) and the raw per-phrase logs of every run reported in docs/results.md and docs/results-language.md.
